item.title: EiskaltDC++ 3.0.0-pre.1
item.description:
# EiskaltDC++ 3.0.0-pre.1
Preview release of the integrated Direct Connect and BitTorrent client.
## Highlights
- Torrent management, per-file selection/priorities, selected-file rechecking, peers, encryption controls and country blocklists. - Unified transfer monitoring and optional DC++ sharing of eligible completed Torrent files, with per-Torrent exclusions. - Global and Torrent-only proxy routing, including authenticated GOST TLS/UDP. - GitHub-hosted authenticated updates with verified staging and installation deferred until an explicitly committed normal application quit. - Refreshed chat formatting controls, file icons, tabs and certificate settings.
## Downloads
Choose exactly one package for your CPU:
- Intel x86_64 only: macOS 14 or newer. - Apple Silicon arm64 only: macOS 26 or newer.
The minimum-OS declarations are checked in every bundled Mach-O dependency. Native testing on each advertised minimum OS is not yet established. Intel execution on the development Mac uses Rosetta, not physical Intel hardware.
## Before Updating
These packages are **not notarized and not Developer ID signed**. App bundles use ad-hoc signatures; macOS may require manual approval before first launch. Sparkle update archives and feeds are separately authenticated with the application's pinned Ed25519 update key. This does not replace Apple notarization.
This is a prerelease. Back up your profile and use care with valuable downloads. Package hashes, source archives and dependency notices accompany the release. Do not infer anonymity from proxy routing or country filters.
Internal macOS build: **30000001** for both architectures.
Regression suites passed 1,973 cases per architecture (211,163 assertions on Apple Silicon; 210,951 under Intel/Rosetta), including controlled shutdown and injected failure checks. Test host: macOS 27.0; the minimum OS versions above were checked statically, not tested on separate minimum-version machines.
Real GOST interoperability passed all eight scenarios on each CPU. Disposable full-app updater tests passed normal installation, canceled quit, forced exit before commit, native macOS termination, and canceled native termination on both CPU builds. Test data remained unchanged and updates did not relaunch without consent. These are host-based tests, not VM/minimum-OS certification.
Application source: `c40689d43`. Dependency sources, local patches and notices are supplied separately; complete bit-for-bit dependency reproducibility is not claimed. Experimental private OpenSSL QA tooling is not part of the app.
